Leo's Sticky Monster Hands: Why Washing Hands Is Fun! — Look at your hands after playing! Millions of tiny invisible germ monsters are throwing a party—unless you grab the soap!
Kids science answer for "hand washing story for kids cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Invisible bacteria love sticking to dirt and sugar on your fingers. Lathering up soap for 20 seconds creates bubbles that lift germs so water washes them right down the drain.
